    Published: 2020-11-13T00:00:00.000Z
    SUMMARY: To find the sum of the interior angle measures of a regular polygon with 20 sides, you can use the formula: 

\[
\text{Sum of interior angles} = (n - 2) \times 180
\]

where \( n \) is the number of sides. For a polygon with 20 sides:

\[
\text{Sum} = (20 - 2) \times 180 = 18 \times 180 = 3240 \text{ degrees}
\]

This means the total sum of the interior angles of a convex polygon with 20 sides is 3240 degrees.
    HIGHLIGHTS:
      - The sum of the interior angles of a regular n-gon is given by the formula (n-2)180. Hence, in our case n=20 and we have the answer of 18(180)=3240 degrees.
